patch_description: Replace the greedy placement with a binary-search-on-KVPR-threshold approach, similar to the best-performing prior program (score 25.69). Key improvement: during feasibility packing, directly record model→GPU assignments, avoiding the fragile re-packing step, and use best-fit (choose the feasible GPU whose resulting KVPR is smallest) rather than first-fit for better balance. We binary search the threshold λ such that all models fit memory-wise and every GPU's KVPR ≤ λ, then return the recorded assignment.
